뒤.x: There is a small garden behind the house.
뒤.t: Also used for time: 한 시간 뒤에 = an hour later (like 후에).

소고기.t: 쇠고기 is an equally standard spelling of the same word.

키.x: My younger brother is very tall.
키.e: Not to be confused with 키 'key' from English.
키.t: Say 키가 커요 (tall) and 키가 작아요 (short) — not 길다/짧다.

영수증.x: Could I have the receipt, please?
영수증.t: Cashiers often ask 영수증 드릴까요? — 'Would you like the receipt?'

춤.t: 'To dance' = 춤을 추다 (추 + 어요 → 춰요), not 춤하다.

드시다.e: Honorific for both eating and drinking.
드시다.t: Use for others you respect, never yourself. 맛있게 드세요 = 'Enjoy your meal.'

다르다.x: Korean and English are very different.
다르다.e: 달라요. Koreans often say 틀리다 (wrong) when they mean 다르다.
다르다.t: The modifier 다른 also means 'other': 다른 사람 = another person.

들르다.forms: 들러요 · 들렀어요 · 들를 거예요 · 들르세요 (ㅡ drops)
들르다.m: to stop by, to drop in
들르다.ex: 집에 가는 길에 편의점에 잠깐 들렀어요.
들르다.x: I stopped by the convenience store briefly on my way home.
들르다.e: Don't mix it up with 들리다 (to be heard), which sounds similar.
들르다.t: It's 들러요, not 들려요: 들르다 just drops ㅡ and is not a 르 irregular.

고구마.ex: 겨울에 따뜻한 고구마를 먹으면 정말 맛있어요.
고구마.x: Warm sweet potatoes taste really good in winter.
고구마.e: Probably from a Japanese dialect word for sweet potato, brought to Korea in the 1700s.
고구마.t: Slang: a 고구마 story is frustratingly slow, like eating dry sweet potato without water.

뿌리다.m: to sprinkle, to spray, to scatter
뿌리다.x: Sprinkle a little salt and pepper on the meat.
뿌리다.e: Used for anything sprinkled or sprayed: salt, water, even perfume (향수를 뿌리다).

변하다.ex: 십 년 동안 이 동네가 많이 변했어요.
변하다.x: This neighborhood has changed a lot over ten years.
변하다.t: 변하다 is gradual change in nature; 바뀌다 is replacing one thing with another.

옥상.x: If you go up to the rooftop, you can see the night sky well.
옥상.t: 옥상 is the flat rooftop you can stand on; 지붕 is the roof covering itself.

한글날.ex: 한글날은 세종대왕이 만든 한글을 기념하는 날이에요.
한글날.x: Hangeul Day is a day to honor the Korean alphabet created by King Sejong.
한글날.e: 한글 'the Korean alphabet' + 날 'day'; it marks the alphabet's proclamation in 1446.
한글날.t: Pronounced [한글랄] — ㄴ becomes ㄹ after ㄹ.

실제로.ex: 사진보다 실제로 보니까 훨씬 더 예뻐요.
실제로.x: It's much prettier in person than in the photos.

돌리다.m: to turn, to spin, to rotate; to hand out; to run (a machine)
돌리다.ex: 주말 아침에 세탁기를 돌리고 청소를 했어요.
돌리다.x: On the weekend morning, I ran the washing machine and cleaned up.
돌리다.e: Causative of 돌다 'to turn': to make something turn.

보일러.x: It got cold, so I turned on the boiler.
보일러.e: From English 'boiler'; in Korea it heats water for floor heating (ondol).
보일러.t: Koreans say 보일러를 켜다/끄다 where Americans would say turn the heat on or off.

성숙하다.ex: 제 동생은 나이에 비해 아주 성숙해요.
성숙하다.x: My younger sibling is very mature for their age.
성숙하다.e: Literally 'become ripe', like fruit ready to pick.

그러자.forms: A. 그러자 B. (B is a reaction that follows A)
그러자.ex: 제가 웃었어요. 그러자 아기도 따라 웃었어요.
그러자.x: I smiled. At that, the baby smiled too.
그러자.t: Only for past events in stories; for 'if you do that' use 그러면 instead.

비추다.m: to shine on, light up; to reflect
비추다.ex: 아침 햇살이 창문으로 방 안을 비추고 있어요.
비추다.x: The morning sun is shining into the room through the window.
비추다.t: 비추다 takes an object (the sun lights up the room); 비치다 doesn't (light shines in).

부수다.x: The child broke his toy and is crying.
부수다.t: 부수다 is doing the breaking; 부서지다 means something gets broken.

귀하다.x: This painting is a truly precious work.
귀하다.e: Literally 'precious, honored'; 귀하 is also a formal 'you' in letters.
귀하다.t: 귀한 손님 (an honored guest) is a common polite collocation.

가늘다.x: That person's fingers are long and slender.
가늘다.e: For thin long things (threads, fingers); flat thin things use 얇다.
가늘다.t: The modifier 가는 looks like 가는 from 가다 'going'; context tells you which.

톤.ex: 이 트럭에는 짐을 5톤까지 실을 수 있어요.
톤.x: This truck can carry up to 5 tons of cargo.
톤.e: From English 'ton'; in Korea it means the metric ton, 1,000 kg.
톤.t: A separate loanword 톤 means 'tone': 목소리 톤 'tone of voice', 피부 톤 'skin tone'.

출연자.m: cast member, performer, guest (on a show)
출연자.ex: 오늘 방송에는 유명한 출연자들이 많이 나와요.
출연자.x: Many famous guests are appearing on today's show.

공교육.ex: 정부는 공교육을 강화하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.
공교육.x: The government is working to strengthen public education.

로그인.x: To log in, first enter your ID and password.
로그인.t: Add 하다 for the verb, 로그인하다; Koreans say 아이디 where Americans say 'username'.

철이 들다.forms: 철이 들어요 · 철이 들었어요 · 철이 든 사람 (ㄹ drops)
철이 들다.m: to grow up, to mature, to come to one's senses
철이 들다.ex: 군대에 다녀온 후에 아들이 철이 들었어요.
철이 들다.x: My son grew up after he came back from the military.
철이 들다.e: Literally 'good sense comes in' — 들다 means to enter.

이따금.forms: 이따금 + verb: 이따금 연락하다, 이따금 생각나다
이따금.x: I think of my hometown friends once in a while.
이따금.t: Don't confuse with 이따가 'a little later'; 이따금 means 'every now and then'.

들이다.m: to let in, to bring in; to spend (time, money, effort); to form (a habit)
들이다.ex: 좋은 습관을 들이는 데는 시간이 걸려요.
들이다.x: It takes time to form a good habit.
들이다.e: Causative of 들다 'to go in': make something go in.
들이다.t: Key pairs: 습관을 들이다 (form a habit), 공을 들이다 (put in effort), 돈을 들이다 (spend money).

십중팔구.forms: 십중팔구가 · 십중팔구를 (mostly used as an adverb)
십중팔구.m: most likely, nine times out of ten
십중팔구.x: If traffic is this bad, we'll almost certainly be late.
십중팔구.e: Literally 'eight or nine out of ten'.

제자리걸음.m: standstill, lack of progress; marking time, walking in place
제자리걸음.ex: 협상이 몇 달째 제자리걸음을 하고 있습니다.
제자리걸음.x: The negotiations have been at a standstill for months.
제자리걸음.e: 제자리 (one's own spot) + 걸음 (step): walking without going anywhere.

영역.x: Artificial intelligence is being used in many fields.
영역.e: Literally 'governed region': first a territory, then any field.

지하실.x: We keep old things in the basement.
지하실.t: 반지하 'half-basement' apartments are cheap housing, made famous abroad by the film Parasite.

비수기.ex: 비수기에 여행하면 돈을 많이 아낄 수 있어요.
비수기.x: If you travel in the off-season, you can save a lot of money.

이재민.x: The flood left hundreds of people displaced.
이재민.t: News pattern: 이재민이 발생하다 'people are displaced'.

일삼다.m: to make a habit of (doing something bad), to keep doing
일삼다.ex: 그 정치인은 막말을 일삼다가 결국 사퇴했어요.
일삼다.x: That politician habitually made offensive remarks and eventually resigned.
일삼다.e: Literally 일 'work' plus 삼다 'to make into' — treating a bad act as one's job.
일삼다.t: Almost always negative: 거짓말, 폭력, 비리를 일삼다.

매이다.m: to be tied, to be fastened; to be tied down (to work or duties)
매이다.ex: 요즘은 회사 일에 매여서 쉴 시간이 없어요.
매이다.x: These days I'm so tied up with work that I have no time to rest.

독선적.x: The team leader is so self-righteous that the team members are struggling.
독선적.e: Literally 'only I am good' — ignoring others' views.

난데없이.m: out of nowhere, out of the blue
난데없이.x: A shower poured down out of nowhere from a clear sky.
난데없이.e: Literally 'with no place it came out from': 난 'came out' + 데 'place' + 없이.

당위성.m: justification, rationale; the case (for doing something)
당위성.ex: 환경 보호의 당위성에 대해서는 모두 동의합니다.
당위성.x: Everyone agrees on the need to protect the environment.
당위성.e: Literally 'the quality of what ought to be done'.

이자율.x: Loan interest rates differ a little from bank to bank.
이자율.t: In news, 금리 is more common than 이자율 for central bank rates.

무기질.x: Vegetables and fruits are rich in vitamins and minerals.
무기질.e: Literally 'inorganic substance', the opposite of 유기질 (organic).

시민 단체.ex: 여러 시민 단체가 환경 보호 운동에 참여했어요.
시민 단체.x: Several civic groups took part in the environmental protection movement.

이질감.m: sense of difference, feeling of foreignness
이질감.ex: 외국에서 오래 살다 와서 한국 문화에 이질감을 느꼈어요.
이질감.x: After living abroad for a long time, I felt Korean culture was foreign to me.
이질감.e: Literally 'feeling that the quality is different'.

혐오감.ex: 폭력적인 장면은 많은 사람에게 혐오감을 줘요.
혐오감.x: Violent scenes cause disgust in many people.
혐오감.t: 혐오 is common in social debates: 혐오 표현 means hate speech.

내분비.x: Hormone problems are treated in the endocrinology department.
내분비.e: Literally 'secreting inside' — hormones go into the blood.

유기물.ex: 흙 속의 유기물은 식물이 잘 자라게 도와줘요.
유기물.x: Organic matter in the soil helps plants grow well.

집대성하다.m: to compile into a comprehensive whole, to synthesize, to systematize
집대성하다.ex: 이 책은 조선 시대 의학 지식을 집대성했습니다.
집대성하다.x: This book compiles the medical knowledge of the Joseon era into one comprehensive work.
집대성하다.e: Literally 'gather into a great completion' — bringing scattered work into one system.
